client_providers.label: n8n workspace

client_providers.secretDestination: No credential is required to test the synthetic starter.

Connect it only after test data and output schema are approved.

client_providers.label: CRM / intake source (production)
client_providers.purpose: Receives approved form events and stores the reviewed handoff.
clientProvides: CRM/form name, vendor API documentation, event schema, and permitted scopes
steps: Provide a documented API and least-privilege service account.
Test a synthetic event, error path, and idempotency check.
